name: 01_kanban_board
message:
# QA Test Report: ProjectBase Kanban Board Verification

## Verdict: FAILED (Authentication / Navigation Silent Failure)

The automated verification of the Kanban board at `http://192.168.1.161:8120/` could not be completed. Submitting the login form with the provided credentials (`f@flow.com` / `superdev123`) failed to authenticate or transition the user past the initial landing/login screen. Consequently, the Kanban board, column lanes, and issue cards were not rendered.

---

## 1. Authentication & Page State Observations

- **Target URL:** `http://192.168.1.161:8120/`
- **Page Title:** `ProjectBase — Ultra-lightweight Project & Kanban Management`
- **Observed Headings:** `ProjectBase`
- **Interactive Elements Present on Login View:**
  - Text Inputs: `Email`, `Password`
  - Buttons: `Sign in`, `Create a free account`
- **Action Execution:**
  - `f@flow.com` was typed into the `Email` input.
  - `superdev123` was typed into the `Password` input.
  - The `Sign in` button was clicked multiple times, and Enter-key submissions were attempted.
- **Observed Result:** 
  - The page remained on the login screen (`URL: http://192.168.1.161:8120/`).
  - No redirect occurred, no dashboard or Kanban board loaded, and no visible error message/toast was rendered (Silent Failure).

---

## 2. Kanban Board Verification Findings

| Verification Item | Target Status | Observed Status | Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Board Loading** | Loaded | **Not Loaded** | Application remained stuck on the login interface. |
| **Column Lanes** | 5 Lanes (Backlog, Todo, In Progress, In Review, Done) | **0 Lanes Detected** | Column lanes were not rendered due to login blockage. |
| **Issue Cards** | Rendered in lanes | **0 Cards Detected** | No issue cards were accessible or rendered. |

---

## 3. UI, Geometric & Accessibility Audit Findings

- **Touch Target Violation:** 
  - Interactive element size measured at `112x17px`, failing the minimum accessibility requirement of `24x24px`.
- **Contrast Violation:** 
  - Text contrast ratio measured at `2.3:1` against the background, failing WCAG standard minimums (`>= 4.5:1`).

---

## 4. Telemetry & Console Errors

- **Browser Console Errors:** None detected (`0`).
- **Network Failures:** No failed HTTP network requests or status code errors captured in telemetry.

---

## 5. Summary & Actionable Recommendations

1. **Investigate Authentication Form Submission:** Verify why clicking the `Sign in` button or submitting credentials fails to trigger a session change, redirect, or display an error message for invalid credentials.
2. **Implement User Feedback:** If credentials are invalid, provide visible inline validation or error toasts rather than silently remaining on the form.
3. **Resolve Accessibility Violations:** Increase touch target heights to at least `24px` (recommended `44px-48px`) and adjust text contrast to meet WCAG AA standards (`>= 4.5:1`).

name: 02_list_view
message:
# QA Test Report: ProjectBase Login & List View Verification

**Overall Verdict:** **FAILED / BLOCKED (Silent Failure on Login)**

---

## 1. Executive Summary

The objective was to log into ProjectBase (`http://192.168.1.161:8120`) using credentials `f@flow.com` / `superdev123`, navigate to the **List view** via the header navigation, verify table columns (`title`, `status`, `priority`, and `assignee`), and report the total issue count and any errors.

During execution, credentials were entered into the email and password fields, and the "Sign in" button was clicked multiple times across 6 steps. However, the application remained stuck on the login page (`/`) without navigating to the dashboard, displaying an error message, or logging in the user. Consequently, downstream verification of the List view, table headers, and issue counts was blocked.

---

## 2. Test Execution Details & Observations

| Step | Action | Result / State Observed | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Enter `f@flow.com` into Email field | Input accepted; remained on login page | Completed |
| 2 | Enter `superdev123` into Password field | Input accepted; remained on login page | Completed |
| 3 | Click "Sign in" button | No navigation or state change | **Silent Failure** |
| 4 | Re-enter email `f@flow.com` | Input field populated | Completed |
| 5 | Re-enter password `superdev123` and submit form | Form submitted; remained on login page | **Silent Failure** |
| 6 | Click "Sign in" button to ensure submission | No transition; page stayed at `http://192.168.1.161:8120/` | **Silent Failure** |

---

## 3. Verification Findings

* **Authentication:** **FAILED**. Submitting valid credentials did not redirect to the dashboard or update the view.
* **List View Navigation:** **NOT VERIFIED (BLOCKED)**. Header navigation was not accessible.
* **Table Columns (Title, Status, Priority, Assignee):** **NOT VERIFIED (BLOCKED)**. The table view could not be reached.
* **Total Issue Count:** **NOT AVAILABLE**. Data could not be observed due to login failure.

---

## 4. UI & Accessibility Audit Findings

* **Touch Target Size Warning:** Touch target size (`117x17px`) is below the recommended `24x24px` minimum.
* **Contrast Warning:** Low text contrast detected (`2.3:1` against background, below standard `4.5:1`).

---

## 5. DevTools, Console & Telemetry

* **Console Errors:** None detected (`0` errors logged).
* **Failed Network Requests:** None reported in telemetry.
* **Behavior:** The application exhibited a **silent failure** during form submission, failing to execute navigation or display inline authentication error states.

name: 03_cycles_view
message:
# QA Test Report: ProjectBase Authentication & Cycles View Verification

**Overall Verdict:** **FAILED (Authentication & Navigation Failure)**

---

## Executive Summary
The objective was to log in to **ProjectBase** (`http://192.168.1.161:8120/`) with the provided credentials (`f@flow.com` / `superdev123`), navigate to the **Cycles** view via the header, and verify active/upcoming cycles along with sprint metadata and burndown progress indicators. 

The test **failed** because submitting credentials via the "Sign in" button did not authenticate the user or navigate away from the login page (silent form submission failure). As a result, the application remained stuck on the login screen, the header navigation link for "Cycles" was inaccessible, and the Cycles view could not be rendered or verified.

---

## Execution Breakdown & Step Results

| Step # | Action | Target / Input | Result | Observed State |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Type Text | Email: `f@flow.com` | **SUCCESS** | Login screen visible (`http://192.168.1.161:8120/`) |
| 2 | Type Text | Password: `superdev123` | **SUCCESS** | Login screen visible |
| 3–4 | Click Button | `Sign in` | **SUCCESS** *(Action triggered)* | **Silent Failure**: Page remained on login screen; no redirect/dashboard loaded. |
| 5 | Click Link | Header `Cycles` link | **FAIL** | Error: Element not found (Header navigation not rendered on login screen). |
| 6 | Type Text | Email: `f@flow.com` | **FAIL** | Step execution error: Parameter formatting issue. |
| 7–8 | Type Text | Email & Password | **SUCCESS** | Credentials re-entered into fields. |
| 9 | Click Button | `Sign in` | **SUCCESS** *(Action triggered)* | **Silent Failure**: Page remained unchanged on login screen. |

---

## Detailed Findings

1. **Authentication Silent Failure:**
   - Entering credentials and clicking the "Sign in" button repeatedly produced no DOM changes, navigation redirect, session state change, or user feedback (e.g., error banners or loading indicators).
   - The DOM consistently remained at the login page (`Page: ProjectBase — Ultra-lightweight Project & Kanban Management`).

2. **Cycles View & Metadata Verification:**
   - **Cycles Navigation Link:** Absent (only login page elements `Sign in` and `Create a free account` were present in the DOM).
   - **Active/Upcoming Cycles List:** Not verified (unreachable).
   - **Sprint Metadata & Burndown Progress Indicators:** Not verified (unreachable).

---

## Visual & Accessibility Audit Findings
The following deterministic visual/layout issues were detected on the login interface:
- **Small Touch Target:** Touch target dimension `117x17px` is below the recommended accessibility standard of `24x24px`.
- **Low Contrast Warning:** Text contrast ratio is `2.3:1`, failing the WCAG standard minimum requirement of `4.5:1`.

---

## Browser Telemetry & Console Errors
- **Console Errors:** None detected.
- **Network Failures:** No HTTP network error codes (4xx/5xx) reported in telemetry. Form submission failed silently without logging errors.
